object.attr: as implemented: USAGE.md: informational. A suspect link doesn't block a commit (MELLON-CHECK-SRS-32); a broken link blocks only where validation reports it (MELLON-CHECK-SRS-34, -35), so "without blocking" was dropped. Also the GUI's warning before an issue (Q-V9).
object.description: The commit dialog shall list the open document's suspect and broken outgoing links.
